results.bug: Incorrect end time calculation using slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime

matched.title: Working-hours check requires the slot to fit every range on that day, not any one

results.judgeReason: Finding #4 is mainly about find-vs-some in the working-hours check, but it also says that `end` is computed from slotStartTime, so the slot end is never checked. That is the planted bug's root cause, the end time using slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime. It points at the working-hours check in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts, the code that has the bug, and states the impact: the slot's end is never checked against working hours. No other finding mentions the end-time calculation.

results.bug: Inaccurate cache status tracking due to unreliable updatedAt field

matched.title: updateMany with empty data never bumps SelectedCalendar.updatedAt

results.judgeReason: Finding #0 identifies the same root cause: the PR relies on SelectedCalendar.updatedAt to report cache status, but the updateMany call with empty data in CalendarService.ts never actually bumps updatedAt, so the 'last updated' timestamp the PR selects and shows is stale and does not reflect real cache activity. It points at the code that tries to refresh the timestamp and explains the impact (inaccurate cache status). Findings #1-#3 cover different issues: UI refetch, locale formatting, and select scope.
